name: Minh Thanh Pagoda
kicker: Hill pagoda with a 72 m tower
summary: Walk Minh Thanh Pagoda, the gold-painted tower on the hill above Pleiku. The tower is 72 m, the ceiling is po mu wood, and the doors are carved. The building dates to 1964. It is a daylight stop in town. It is not Buu Minh, the pagoda in the tea hills on the way toward Chu Đăng Ya. Gate hours and any donation are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The gold-painted tower and the pagoda roofs above Pleiku

notice.title: Not Buu Minh pagoda
notice.body: Buu Minh sits on the road toward Chu Đăng Ya. Minh Thanh is the gold tower on the hill above Pleiku. They are different sites.

body: The tower is the landmark above town. It is 72 m and gold-painted, on a pagoda built in 1964, with a ceiling of po mu wood and carved wooden doors. Walk the grounds in daylight so the tower and the roofs stay in one view.
A short taxi from central Pleiku is the way up. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival. Buu Minh is the pagoda in the tea hills on the way toward Chu Đăng Ya. It is not this hill.

figures.caption: The main hall, stair, and carved roof
figures.alt: Wooden hall of Minh Thanh Pagoda with a tiled roof, guardian lions, and a brick stair

gettingThere: Minh Thanh stands on the hill above Pleiku. A short taxi from the center is the way up. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku
legs.body: By taxi from the center. The ride is short. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Gate hours and any donation are Check on arrival. No child rule is set out.
